common: isometric 2:1, true pixel art 16-bit cozy game, strict pixel grid, clean 1-pixel outlines, flat 2-3 tone shading, no anti-aliasing; room EMPTY of people; no text, no letters. A wide landscape isometric office floor cutaway (about 16:9, wider than tall) on a plain solid single-color background. Include 10 to 12 empty desks each with a monitor and a chair, arranged in two or more rows with generous aisles between them so a small character can stand in front of each chair; a small table with an inbox tray at the front center (team leader seat); a door (entrance); a blank whiteboard on a wall; a sofa lounge area; and many props: lamps, rugs, bookshelves, potted plants, window views, wall decorations.
